title: Thailand Cambodia Vietnam Itinerary 10 Days
highlights: Explore the vibrant cultures, stunning landscapes, and rich histories of Southeast Asia with our Thailand Cambodia Vietnam itinerary 10 days.
Visit Thailand’s Phi Phi Islands and explore Maya Bay, famous for its crystal-clear waters and dramatic limestone cliffs, also, featured in the Hollywood film "The Beach.
Marvel at the world’s largest religious monument, Cambodia’s Angkor Wat, a stunning temple dedicated to Lord Vishnu, featuring intricate carvings and towering spires.
Cycle your way through charming rural villages, interacting with locals and experiencing authentic Vietnamese culture as you visit Ninh Binh.
overview:
About the destinations:
This Thailand Cambodia Vietnam itinerary 10 days highlights a range of captivating destinations. Phuket enchants with its pristine beaches and vibrant nightlife. Bangkok, a bustling metropolis, showcases ornate temples and lively street life. Phnom Penh invites exploration of historical sites, including the Royal Palace and the Tuol Sleng Museum. Siem Reap is home to the awe-inspiring Angkor Wat and offers serene boat rides on Tonle Sap Lake. Hanoi captivates with its rich culture and history, while Ninh Binh dazzles with its stunning landscapes.

know_before_you_go: Kindly carry a valid photo ID proof. All foreign nationals must carry their passport as a proof of identity.
Images are for representation purpose only.
Please note that prices are dynamic and may change in the peak season and on blackout dates.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the stay property will be charged at actuals.
Kindly do not litter and help keep the destinations clean.
Please note that the timings and duration of pick-up and drop-off transfers may vary based on certain factors like traffic, weather conditions, natural calamities, etc.
Prices may fluctuate with any change in services/hotels. The difference in the cost shall be borne by the client in case of any amendment in the package due to an increase in the number of guests.
It is advisable that you dress modestly (keeping your shoulders and knees covered) when visiting any religious sites and temples.
To mitigate health risks, it is strongly advised to refrain from drinking tap water directly. Instead, carry refillable water bottles.
It is recommended that you purchase travel insurance. Please note that the travel insurance is not included in the package price.
It is advisable to carry enough cash while travelling. Please note that carrying a minimum 10,000 Baht in cash is mandatory while travelling to Thailand.
Smoking is prohibited in most public areas therefore, designated smoking areas should be used.
The official currency of Vietnam is the Vietnamese Dong (VND). It’s advisable to carry some cash for small purchases, though credit cards are widely accepted.
Always have tissues and hand sanitizer with you as there is no guarantee that there will be toilet paper or water and soap when you use the restroom.
Indian tourists can obtain a Vietnam visa online (E-Visa) or upon arrival at the airport with a validity of 30 days. Charges have to be paid by the tourists.

Cambodia is a tropical country with some risk of malaria and other diseases. If you are planning to visit rural areas or stay for a long time, you may need to get some vaccinations before your trip. Some of the recommended vaccines are hepatitis A, hepatitis B, typhoid, cholera, yellow fever, Japanese encephalitis and rabies.
Cambodia is a predominantly Buddhist country that values modesty and respect in dress code. Shorts, tights, plunging necklines, miniskirts, and other revealing clothing are not permitted.
It is advisable that you bring insect repellent and remember to use it on a regular basis.
Please note that Cambodian society is relatively conservative, and public displays of affection are considered disrespectful.

As per Indian Govt. rules, a Tax Collection at Source (TCS) of 5% for Foreign Remittance shall be paid additionally that you can claim while filing the income tax returns. Kindly consult a tax advisor/consultant for further information.

If in case any traveller wants to or decides to leave the trip in the middle, all the expenses from the point onwards will be borne by the traveller. Neither the operator nor Thrillophilia will be held responsible for such decisions or for any refund.

In cases of force majeure events (e.g., natural disasters, political unrest, or other unforeseeable circumstances), [Thrillophilia] reserves the right to reschedule tours & treks or offer alternative itineraries to ensure the safety and well-being of clients and staff.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Phuket | Half-day Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Welcome to Thailand! Upon arrival in Phuket, you will be transferred to the hotel. After checking in, get ready for a half-day sightseeing tour. Visit iconic landmarks like the Big Buddha and Wat Chalong, and enjoy the views of the lush landscapes from Nakkerd Hills. As the sun sets, stroll through the bustling streets of Phuket Old Town, where you can try local cuisine (extra cost) and experience the vibrant nightlife. Later, get transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip to Phi Phi Islands
days.desc: Today, enjoy a day trip to the Phi Phi Islands. Swim in crystal-clear waters teeming with marine life, and relax on pristine beaches like Maya Bay, a famous spot on the islands that was also featured in the Hollywood film  “The Beach”, starring Leonardo di Caprio. Also, explore the Viking Cave, featuring ancient wall paintings. Witness the tropical beauty of Thailand at Loh Samah Bay and conclude your day trip at Monkey Beach. Later, get transferred to the hotel in Phuket for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Siem Reap | Boat Ride on Tonle Sap Lake
days.desc: Check out and get transferred to Siem Reap, the gateway to Angkor. After checking in at the hotel, enjoy a scenic boat ride on Tonle Sap Lake, surrounded by floating villages. You may also get a chance to marvel at a stunning sunset over the lake. After the boat ride, you will be dropped off at the hotel. The evening invites you to explore the night markets or relax at your hotel, gearing up for the grand exploration of Angkor Wat on the next day.

days.title: Day Trip to Angkor Wat
days.desc: Today, get ready for an immersive experience at Angkor as you board your transfer to the iconic Angkor Wat, the world’s largest religious structure. Explore the sprawling Angkor Thom, where nature intertwines with architecture. Also, marvel at the smiling stone faces at Bayon Temple. Each temple at Angkor reveals the grandeur of the Khmer Empire, offering a glimpse into Cambodia's rich heritage and stunning artistry. Later, get transferred to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Hanoi | Leisure Day
days.desc: After checking out of the hotel, get transferred to the airport for a flight (tickets not included) to Hanoi, Vietnam's capital. After reaching, check in at your hotel and enjoy a leisurely day exploring the city at your own pace. You can stroll around 87 May Street, visit St. Joseph’s Cathedral, or relax at Hanoi Botanical Garden. You can also consider exploring local markets and sampling local street food like pho and banh mi. Later, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Hanoi City Tour
days.desc: Embark on a full day of sightseeing in Hanoi. Visit the Ngoc Son Temple, followed by the bright red Huc Bridge. Explore the Temple of Literature, Vietnam's first university. Also, visit Bat Trang Ceramic Village, where you can shop for local handicrafts.Gain insights into the colonial era of Vietnam at Hoa Lo Prison. After this, you can spend some time relaxing by the Hoan Kiem Lake, enjoying the cool and calm atmosphere. Later, you will be transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip to Ninh Binh | Cycle Tour to Bich Dong
days.desc: On this day, enjoy a day trip to Ninh Binh, known for its stunning landscapes. Enjoy a boat ride through the picturesque Tam Coc caves, surrounded by limestone karsts. Then, embark on a cycling tour to Bich Dong Pagoda, exploring charming villages and lush rice paddies as you make your way. Take in the breathtaking views and immerse yourself in the serene beauty of this region. After the tour ends, get transferred to the hotel in Hanoi for an overnight stay.
